utility.name: LiME - Linux Memory Extractor
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description:
Installs LiME from github repo.
NOTE: LiME captures RAM on whatever kernel it is built against, but analysing that image in Volatility needs a symbol table (ISF) for the captured kernel. The volatility3 module ships ISFs for the current Debian 12 base kernels, so a capture meant for Volatility analysis should come from a covered base; an uncovered kernel needs a fresh ISF first (see the volatility3 module and the update-volatility-isf skill).
